dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-colored rings with jagged, high-frequency edge geometry. The gradient transitions sharply from a dark-grey exterior to a light-tan or white interior band. The most distinct structures are elongated and interconnected, forming a network rather than isolated circles.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of isolated solid blobs. High-intensity pixels are primarily concentrated along the thin perimeters of the annuli. Small, localized clusters of high-intensity pixels (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) are visible only at the intersection points where multiple ring perimeters converge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent central-flank annuli form an irregular scalene triangle. The topmost centroid sits superior to a central pair that are horizontally aligned. The angular relationship between the central-most annulus and its two nearest neighbors on the dorsal-posterior axis is approximately 145 degrees.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex reticulated or tessellated macro-pattern where individual annuli are fused into a continuous lattice-like structure across the mid-section.
